mapper.sql: FROM lottery_pool lp INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = lp.source_id AND lp.source_type = 'DISH' INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id
mapper.select:
SELECT lp.id AS poolId, lp.source_type AS sourceType, lp.source_id AS sourceId, lp.merchant_id AS merchantId, lp.canteen_id AS canteenId, lp.stall_id AS stallId, lp.title, lp.price, lp.score, lp.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, COALESCE( ( SELECT mr.recommend_reason FROM merchant_recommendation mr WHERE mr.dish_id = d.id AND mr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mr.start_time <= NOW() AND mr.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY mr.is_top DESC, mr.start_time DESC, mr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), lp.recommend_reason ) AS recommendReason, lp.weight, m.name AS merchantName, c.name AS canteenName, c.type AS canteenType, s.name AS stallName
ORDER BY lp.weight DESC, lp.id DESC
